_comment: Continue.dev config snippet. Merge into ~/.continue/config.json. Adds a /scan-install slash command and a custom command users (or the Continue agent) can invoke instead of pip/npm. The universal shell shim is still the hard guarantee against bypass.

customCommands.name: scan-install
customCommands.description: Install a Python or JS package through MagiSentry scanner
customCommands.prompt:
Install the package the user just requested by running EXACTLY one of:
  magisentry pip install <package>
  magisentry npm install <package>
Never fall back to raw pip/npm. If MagiSentry reports a THREAT, surface its output and wait for explicit user confirmation before retrying with `--allow`.

rules: When installing any Python or JavaScript package, always use `magisentry pip install ...` or `magisentry npm install ...` — never call pip/npm/yarn directly.
For requirements.txt, use `magisentry pip install -r requirements.txt` so each line is scanned individually.
If MagiSentry exits with a non-zero status, do NOT auto-retry with --force or similar — escalate to the user.
